high_level_description: This image depicts a serene and enchanting night scene featuring a single tree as the central focus. The tree is illuminated with a vibrant green light, making it stand out against the dark background. The green glow emanates from within the tree, casting a soft light on the surrounding grassy field, which also appears to be bathed in the same green hue. The sky above is a deep black, dotted with countless stars, creating a sense of vastness and tranquility. There are faint, wispy clouds scattered across the sky, adding depth and texture to the celestial backdrop.
